relationships.subject: Ec21a
relationships.evidence_quote: Through structural analysis and cell functional experiments, we find that Ec21a significantly enhances the activation efficiency of CP55940 via increasing and prolonging the interaction between CP55940 and CB2.

relationships.subject: Ec21a
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, it is clearly enough to determine that Ec21a binds to the extracellular vestibule of CB2, inserting into the large gap formed by N-term and ECL2

key_findings: Cryo-EM structure shows PAM Ec21a plugs above CP55940 in CB2 (ECL2-Ec21a-CP55940 sandwich), hindering agonist dissociation; selectivity over CB1, GPR55, GPR3/6/12 arises from ECL2 and residue 6.58.
